english.meaning: to take or carry something in the hand
english.note: 拎住 means holding something; 拎出去 means take it out.

exampleSentences.english: You’d obviously spend the money on the real thing. No point buying a fake—you wouldn’t look good taking it out.
exampleSentences.traditional: 實會捨得使錢落去買囖，冇理由話去買個冒牌嘅，你拎佢出去都唔好喇。

exampleSentences.english: Why didn’t you take it to the goldfish shop to sell then?
exampleSentences.traditional: 啊嗰陣時你點解唔拎出去金魚舖賣？
